title: Maidenless
description:
::::::::::::::::::::::ABOUT THE GAME:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

We are currently in the Combat Alpha phase of Early Access, features listed below are planned and not yet implemented!

To get access to the Alpha please head to our discord and apply for a key!

Planned Features

Maidenless will be an arena PVP game with Souls-like combat.
There will be multiple weapon types and various armor options to help you customise your preferred playstyle, whether that be unga bunga with a big club
or a ranged caster with a focus on aiding your allies, I plan to make build diversity a focus point!

Player equipment, skills and attributes will be freely changeable between matches so you can always try something new or switch your build to fit what your team needs.
description_short: Enter the Endless Arena and fight other players in structured 1v1, 3v3 and free for all PVP!
